claim: Automated a 6-hour/week manual Excel reporting workflow to under 10 minutes/week, saving an estimated 303 analyst-hours per year (97.2% reduction).
caveat: Baseline timing is from a documented 14-step workflow replica; actual analyst efficiency may vary.

claim: Backtested SPC early-warning engine on 1,097 Phase II SECOM lots: Western Electric rules achieved 100% recall (all 46 failures detected) with 4.23% precision.
caveat: Precision is well below the 60% target due to low fail prevalence (4.19%). High alert rate limits operational value without further rule refinement.

claim: SPC alerts reduced defect-to-detection latency by 100% (median 18.0 hours saved) versus a next-day-08:00 manual report baseline.
caveat: Latency is conditional on detected failures and assumes zero compute/response delay in a historical backtest.

claim: Decomposed OEE into Availability (91.29%), Performance (84.50%), and Quality (96.46%) across 4 lines x 3 shifts x 180 days of simulated MES data.
caveat: MES data is simulated with fixed seed and injected scenarios.

claim: Pareto analysis identified top-3 scrap causes (dimensional, surface defect, contamination) accounting for 74.38% of total scrap cost.
caveat: Based on simulated MES quality events.

claim: Modeled a 30% combined loss-reduction scenario projecting OEE from 74.41% to 78.96% (+4.55 pts) with projected annual recoverable value of $1,688,452.14.
caveat: This is a MODELED projection, not a realized financial result. Assumes $22.50/unit contribution margin from config.yaml and 30% reduction in top-3 losses.

claim: Passed 65 automated data quality checks with zero violations across PostgreSQL star schema.
SQL-to-DAX KPI reconciliation passed within 0.1% tolerance (max diff: 1.49e-14%).
Saved $1.69M in annual scrap and production losses.
caveat: UNSAFE: This presents a modeled projection as a realized saving. Use 'Projected annual recoverable value of $1.69M under 30% loss-reduction scenario' instead.

claim: Prevented 38,047 defective units from reaching customers.
caveat: UNSAFE: No defects were prevented. 38,047 is the total scrap count in simulated MES data. SPC alerts are a backtested detection capability, not a prevention mechanism.

claim: Improved factory OEE by 4.55 percentage points.
caveat: UNSAFE: 4.55 pts is a modeled what-if projection. No factory OEE was actually improved.
